links.comparator_used: Non-customized deployment of the sepsis model (a common policy across diagnostic categories); the abstract does not name the comparator explicitly
links.outcome: Diagnostic odds ratio and excess cost of sepsis care to CMS
links.effect: Significantly higher diagnostic odds ratio and reduced costs of sepsis care; potential US $4.6 billion in excess cost savings for CMS with powerful predictive models
links.tradeoff: Net benefit depended significantly on compliance factors (noncompliance, treatment efficacy, tolerance for false alarms).
